title: Chapter 334 World Recovery (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 334 World Recovery (Part 2)

In the camp war between the local camp and the evil god camp, with the strong participation of the Zerg, the evil god camp suffered its first large-scale retreat since records began.

Wu Qing's personal actions, the Zerg and Protoss's battles everywhere, and the rapidly spreading reputation of the Zerg and Protoss in this world, made Wu Qing no longer worry about system resources.

In addition to countless Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, the main combat arms of the Zerg and Protoss have been hatching, materializing, and deployed on various battlefields.

There are more and more Zerg bases in this world. The Zerg bases in each area hatch Zerg arms in a targeted manner according to the different enemies they face, and assist the local camp armies in various places to launch attacks on the evil god camp army.

No matter which race of the evil god camp comes on the field, they are not the opponent of the Zerg army.

Under the leadership of the Zerg army, the armies of various races in the local camp have conquered cities and plundered land all the way, and have taken back all the territories they have lost.

That's not all. The Zerg army has no intention of stopping at all, and has the momentum to defeat the evil god camp in one fell swoop.

A large amount of territory was suddenly taken back, and many races in the native camp could not digest it for a while, and had different opinions on whether to continue to fight with the Zerg.

Those races in the native camp that still have spare strength will of course seize this opportunity to follow the Zerg army and occupy more territory.

Those races in the native camp who are really powerless can only temporarily stop fighting, recuperate, and prepare to fight again next year.

As the direct forces of the Zerg, the Great Xia Territory and the Alliance have the authority of the world rules that exceeds that of the super clans. Everyone has obtained unimaginable promotions, and ordinary people have the strength of elite troops of other races.

These people only need a little training, practice the Nine Changes of the Silkworm, and configure the Zerg biological colonization equipment, and they will be powerful warriors on the battlefield.

This makes the troops of the Great Xia Territory and the Alliance abundant.

Under the leadership of Hu Tu, the Great Xia Territory followed the footsteps of the Zerg army and made the territory spread throughout the sphere of influence of the evil god camp.

The Great Xia army led by Wu Cong followed the Zerg army to fight everywhere. The size of the army continued to expand, and the combat effectiveness of the soldiers continued to break through and improve.

The Great Xia army has become one of the strongest armies in the world.

Wu Cong's strength, like taking a plane, recovered quickly and continued to break through and improve, and now has reached the nine-star level.

This is the welfare of the world's rules and will for special personnel under the Zerg, helping them to quickly improve their strength.

In addition to Wu Cong, Meng, Hu Wei, Shi Gan, Yu Chong and Bai Yan of the alliance, as important figures of the alliance, their strength has also been improved to the level of nine stars, which is a strength they dared not to think of before.

There are also many important personnel under the Zerg, whose strength has been greatly improved, to a level of strength they dared not to dream of before.

This is the huge benefit that Wu Qing and the Zerg have won for the members of the forces under their rule.

The Daxia Army and the Alliance Army, which have been fighting with the Zerg Army, have many soldiers who have reached five-star strength and become one of the most powerful arms in the world.

They practiced the Nine Changes of the Silkworm and used the Zerg biological colonization suits to fight. Their combat power was very strong and they were invincible on the battlefield.

With the reputation of the Zerg, the Alliance developed very quickly. Many races of the local camps applied to join the Alliance. After passing the layers of assessments of the Alliance, they could enter the Alliance and belong to the Zerg, enjoying the unique world rule authority in the world.

The growing and powerful Silkworm Knights also organized a huge army. In addition to assisting the work of the Protoss Arbitration Court, they also participated in the camp war.

Now in this world, there are countless people practicing the Nine Changes of the Silkworm. The Nine Changes of the Silkworm no longer needs the Silkworm Knights to promote it. Instead, a large number of people of various races flocked to participate in the assessment, hoping to inherit the Nine Changes of the Silkworm.

Except for a few who were lucky enough to join the Knights of the Silkworm, most of those who practiced the Nine Changes of the Silkworm entered the armies of various races in the native camp and became high-quality soldiers in various armies.

Now many native camp races with weak heritage have collectively switched to practicing the Nine Changes of the Silkworm of the Zerg, and no one is questioning the purpose of the Zerg anymore.

The Zerg solved the weird problem with the power of one race, and led the native camp to counterattack the evil god camp. Such achievements are recognized by the rules and will of the world, and there is absolutely no falsehood.

Such a powerful Zerg has no need to play any tricks in practicing the exercises.

The Protoss Arbitration Court continues to clean up the weirdness of this world, find out the various mutant weirdness hidden in the native camp, and either subdue or eliminate it.

After the weird interlayer world was destroyed by Wu Qing, the ordinary weirdness of this world is no longer a concern. Without the spatial projection influence of the weird interlayer world, various weirdnesses can only rely on the jurisdiction of neutral and powerful weirdness such as the Weird Lord of the Endless Mountains in order to survive.

Just as the Lord of the Endless Mountain Yongweird said to Wu Qing, in addition to the weird mezzanine world, this world also has many mezzanine worlds. Every neutral and powerful weird occupies a piece of territory and owns some secret mezzanine worlds.

The places occupied by these powerful weirds are all forbidden places that normal creatures in this world dare not easily set foot in.

Now the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal is leading the handling of weird affairs in the local camp. In the eyes of the Protoss, there is no such thing as a taboo place.

The forbidden places where the powerful weirds hide are visited one by one by the Protoss strongmen of the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal.

For those powerful weirds who are sane and can make sense, the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal will not kill them all, but will discuss a solution to regulate the various weirds under the powerful weirds.

For those powerful weirds that cannot communicate normally, whether it is a mental problem or a personality problem, they will be hit hard by the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal.

The nine-star Protoss Light Archon and the nine-star Protoss Dark Archon can easily defeat the powerful weirds in this world, and not many weirds can pose a threat to them.

It is not difficult for the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal strongmen who are favored by the will of the world rules to eliminate the various powerful weirds that are strongly suppressed by the will of the world rules.

Really powerful weirdness like the Weird Lord of the Endless Mountains did not need Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects to warn them, they all became very honest and cooperative.

With the existence of the Gods Arbitration Court, the weirdness problem in this world has been completely solved.

It will only take a while for all kinds of weirdness to be completely restrained by the Gods Arbitration Court, and the nights in this world will become as quiet and peaceful as the normal world.
